column2: Daemonic Incursion
$ORDER$Daemonic Incursion into $OTHER_TITLE$
Recent Daemonic Incursion
A rift to the Realm of Chaos opened in this realm not long ago.
Ravaged by Daemons
A daemonic host tore through this realm before it was driven back into the warp. Fields lie burned and the survivors are slow to return to work.
Banisher of Daemons
This ruler threw a daemonic host back into the warp, and the faithful sing of it.
Daemonic Incursions
While the winds of magic are strong, the Chaos realms of the warp can open rifts into mortal realms and send daemonic hosts through.
The Chaos realms of the warp never open rifts into mortal realms.

The sky over [incursion_rift.GetName] turns the colour of a fresh wound, and the air fills with the hammering of brass drums. A rift has torn open into the Realm of Chaos, and the Blood God's daemons pour through it, howling for skulls.

A sickly green mist rolls over [incursion_rift.GetName], and with it comes the drone of a billion flies. A rift has torn open into the Realm of Chaos, and the Plaguefather's daemons shamble through it, chanting their tallies of disease.

A cloying perfume drifts across [incursion_rift.GetName], and those who breathe it hear laughter and sweet promises. A rift has torn open into the Realm of Chaos, and the Dark Prince's daemons dance through it.

The stars above [incursion_rift.GetName] wheel into impossible shapes and the very ground shimmers and changes. A rift has torn open into the Realm of Chaos, and the Changer of Ways' daemons spill through it in a storm of warpfire.
The veil between worlds tears over [incursion_rift.GetName]. A rift has opened into the Realm of Chaos, and a host of daemons from every one of the Ruinous Powers pours through it.
To arms! Drive them back into the warp!
Even the gods' servants must bow to me.
A Rift in Realspace

Terrible news comes from the realm of [incursion_target.GetTitledName]. A rift into the Realm of Chaos has opened over [incursion_rift.GetName], and a daemonic host now marches through [incursion_target.GetHerHis] lands.
May the gods protect us.
Tidings from the Warp

Seers wake screaming of brass and blood, and in every army the soldiers grow quick to anger. The Realm of Khorne has grown mighty, and its Bloodthirsters press hard against the veil. The Blood God's eye is turning towards the mortal world.

Wells sour, crops rot in the field and the fevers linger longer than they should. The Garden of Nurgle is in full bloom, and the Plaguefather's daemons are eager to share his gifts with the mortal world.
Dreams grow sweeter and more troubling, and the wealthy throw ever wilder feasts. The Realm of Slaanesh is ascendant, and the Dark Prince's daemons lean close to the veil, whispering promises.
Comets burn in strange colours and the wizards' spells twist in their hands. The Realm of Tzeentch is ascendant, and the Changer of Ways weaves new schemes for the mortal world.
Every omen points the same way. The Realm of Chaos Undivided has grown strong, and its daemons, sworn to no single god, gather at the edge of the veil.
The legions of Khorne have marched on the [From.PrimaryTitle.GetName]. For now its daemons are needed at home, though the Blood God's own hosts are hungry for still more war.
Nurgle's plague legions have crept into the [From.PrimaryTitle.GetName], and its daemons must fight off the rot before they can look to the mortal world.
The seductive hosts of Slaanesh have danced their way into the [From.PrimaryTitle.GetName], and its daemons turn inward to drive them out.
Tzeentch's daemons have slipped into the [From.PrimaryTitle.GetName] through a thousand twisting paths, and its masters must untangle the Changer's schemes before looking outward.

The impossible has happened. The Ruinous Powers have set aside their endless war and stand together, and the full weight of the Realm of Chaos bears down upon the veil. May the gods of men protect us all.
In the deep forests the herdstones drip with blood and the brayhorns sound for nights on end. The warherds have gathered under one Great Bray, and soon they will burst from the trees.
The storm in the [From.PrimaryTitle.GetName] has passed, for now. The warp is as calm as it ever is, which is to say not calm at all.
The gods are restless.
We must keep watch.
Realms can be the target of a §RDaemonic Incursion§! (Araby, far from the polar gates, is the safest)
